purpose: confirm whether discovery-set mean-barrier non-identifiability recurs across held-out NASICON compositions under two frozen barrier conventions

mean_ekra_to_full_rate.observable: arithmetic mean of event.ekra over positive-probability directed events
mean_ekra_to_full_rate.target: sum of event.probability over all positive-probability directed events

nonnegative_directional_barrier.observable: arithmetic mean of event.barrier after restricting to positive-probability events with barrier >= 0 meV
nonnegative_directional_barrier.target: sum of event.probability over the same nonnegative-barrier events

primary_endpoints: number of held-out compositions with at least one tolerance-matched pair
number of held-out compositions whose maximum matched-pair rate ratio meets the frozen channel threshold
pooled fraction of tolerance-matched pairs meeting the frozen channel threshold
selection_policy: Within each held-out composition enumerate all 1,225 unordered configuration pairs. Report every tolerance-matched pair count and the maximum target ratio; do not substitute a different tolerance or endpoint after inspection.
multiplicity_policy: This is a deterministic finite-corpus confirmation, not a sampling-based significance test. Report composition-level and pooled descriptive endpoints without p-values.
interpretation_boundary: Passing confirms recurrence only within the supplied initial-configuration corpus. It does not establish long-time diffusion, conductivity, causal mechanism, or transfer to experimental pellets.
sealed_test_interaction: This scan does not access or alter the separately sealed paper-level benchmark test.
